currentCollectionsAudited.roleInSystem: One of three synchronized projections of permanent academic missions (along with mission_realms and student_mission_catalog).
currentCollectionsAudited.findings: Currently stores 16 documents keyed by permanent mission ID (e.g., upsc_cse_prelims, rpsc_ras_prelims). Historically labelled "recruitments", but semantically represents permanent exam architectures and blueprints.
currentCollectionsAudited.separationRequirement: Must NOT be overwritten or repurposed as transient yearly recruitment cycles. Transient cycles require a distinct model and decoupled lifecycle.

currentCollectionsAudited.roleInSystem: Student-specific push delivery layer keyed by nc_${uid}_${opportunityId}.
currentCollectionsAudited.findings: Coupled with sentinel_drafts and notification_history. Designed for personalized alert delivery and user read-state tracking, not canonical recruitment lifecycle state.
currentCollectionsAudited.separationRequirement: Remains the downstream delivery pipeline. It should consume reduced RecruitmentCycle career signals rather than storing monolithic recruitment cycle state.

currentCollectionsAudited.roleInSystem: Draft notification staging pipeline for human review or automated worker broadcast.
currentCollectionsAudited.separationRequirement: Can be triggered when a verified CareerSignalEvent is reduced into an active opportunity or process update signal.

permanentMissions.lifecycle: Permanent, multi-year, syllabus-driven. Survives indefinitely across yearly cycles.
permanentMissions.invariants: DigiBook units, topic nodes, and Crucible orbits are never deleted upon cycle termination.

recruitmentCycles.lifecycle: Time-bounded, event-driven (e.g. upsc_cse_2026). Active during notification, application, exam, and result stages.
recruitmentCycles.invariants: Reaches terminal state (CLOSED / CANCELLED) without altering permanent mission.

careerSignalEvents.lifecycle: Immutable audit log of official government notifications, corrigenda, and schedules.
